decision: Use per-worker conservative completion timing for duration-bound Qubes resource samples and validate each worker independently before calibration evidence is accepted.

reviews.reason: A round-level minimum offset can hide a worker whose qrexec/resource response completes after the synthetic workload window, creating optimistic resource evidence.

reviews.preferred: fail closed on any late worker rather than accept a fast sibling worker as representative
reviews.reason: Distributed workers can have asymmetric transport or scheduling delays; evidence must be attributable to the worker whose resources are being qualified.

reviews.preferred: record completion offsets around existing probes without adding transport calls
reviews.reason: The stronger timing evidence adds no qrexec round-trips, VMs, daemons, or mission mutations; it only records local timing around calls already made.

rejected.approach: retain one minimum offset per sampling round
rejected.failure: a fast worker can mask a late worker and falsely qualify post-workload resource data

rejected.approach: use the maximum round offset but copy it to every worker
rejected.failure: conservative but loses worker attribution and can reject healthy workers without identifying the delayed worker

rejected.approach: add a second remote timestamp or telemetry service
rejected.failure: higher fidelity but adds qrexec traffic, clock-correlation complexity, and operational surface before real Qubes qualification is available

requirements: each worker retains exactly one observed completion offset per sampling round
all per-worker offsets are monotonic and inside the active workload window
one delayed worker fails qualification even if another worker completes on time
collector validates worker timing independently rather than deduplicating offsets across the fleet

lesson: Fleet-level timing summaries are not sufficient qualification evidence when distributed workers can experience asymmetric qrexec and scheduler latency; temporal provenance must remain worker-specific.
